title: Quiet room study
alt: A softly lit editorial collage of a desk, wall art, and warm interior objects.
caption: A calm desk corner with enough negative space to think.
detail: A starter inspiration card for the visual archive. Replace this with a real room, product, artwork, or image note when the first Found by Fay content is ready.

title: A shape to shop later
alt: An atmospheric still life with warm neutral objects and layered textures.
caption: Use this card style for affiliate finds without making the feed feel like a store.
detail: Affiliate cards can open a detail view with disclosure language and then link to an external shop, Amazon Storefront, or product page.

title: Reference with a credit trail
alt: A visual reference board with layered art, paper, and muted color.
caption: For art, photos, articles, or source-led references.
detail: Source cards give credit room to breathe. Add the original creator, publication, museum, shop, or article link in the data file.

title: Save what keeps catching your eye.
caption: Text-only moments can break up the image rhythm and make the archive feel human.
detail: Use note cards for observations, mood fragments, shopping principles, or tiny essays that do not need an image.

title: An outbound discovery
alt: A styled editorial image used as a placeholder for an outbound discovery.
caption: Cards can also go straight to an outside destination.
detail: External cards are useful for source articles, Pinterest pins, storefront pages, and anything that does not need an internal detail view.

title: Texture library
alt: Layered neutral textures, paper, and warm-toned visual references.
caption: A place for surface, material, and color notes.
detail: This card demonstrates another modal-backed inspiration item. Add as many records as needed; the page progressively loads them into the masonry feed.

title: Warm minimal object
alt: A warm minimal object study in an editorial composition.
caption: Starter space for a product, object, or shop note.
detail: Use the affiliateUrl field when this becomes a monetized link. The modal will automatically show the affiliate disclosure for affiliate cards.

alt: A quiet image-led card in the Found by Fay starter gallery.
detail: Image-only cards keep the gallery from becoming too text-heavy. The alt text still gives screen-reader users useful context.

title: The homepage is the product.
caption: No blog index, no shop grid, no category maze. Just the archive.
detail: This note preserves the Linear guardrail directly in the content system so future edits keep the one-page-first direction intact.

title: Source to revisit
alt: An editorial placeholder image for a source-led discovery.
caption: A card for articles, shops, pins, museums, or reference pages.
detail: Use sourceUrl for non-affiliate source links. Use affiliateUrl only for monetized destinations.
